title: vault-head — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins the byte-level contract for the Phase 2 vault-head fork-consistency primitive (MYND-416; spec docs/spec/sync-protocol.md §3-§5, with the MYH1 device-local baseline at docs/spec/protocol.md §9.16 — pinned separately by the 'vault-head-state' category — and the head_mac_key context 'vault-head-mac' at §3.4). The head is sync-wire-only (no on-disk magic): an HMAC-SHA-256 over a canonically-encoded record under head_mac_key = DeriveSubkey(root_key, 'vault-head-mac'). Two case kinds: 'encode' pins the canonical head_mac_input, head_mac, and head_id (covering G1 version-vector inner encoding, G2 lexicographic merge-parent ordering, G3 head_id = SHA-256(head_mac_input || head_mac), and SHA-256 domain separation); 'verify' pins the on-pull VV-dominance decision (rollback-rejection / extension / fork-incomparability, §5.3). NOTE: this file is the SCHEMA only — the cases.json golden vectors are authored by MYND-418 (they require the Rust reference implementation, MYND-417). The Rust reference will live in the main repo (protocol crate, MYND-417); cross-impl bit-identical output is the acceptance bar.

input_device_id_hex.description: 16-byte VV-actor device_id (hex). Client-generated random, distinct from the secret per-device token (sync-protocol.md §4.1).

counter.description: u64 authored-head count for this device. Encoded big-endian (8 bytes) in vv_canonical.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'vault-head/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

oneOf.title: encode — pin the canonical head_mac_input, head_mac, and head_id

input_root_key_hex.description: 32-byte root_key (hex). The runner derives head_mac_key via DeriveSubkey(root_key, 'vault-head-mac') (protocol.md §3.2 / §3.4) before computing the MAC.

input_manifest_hash_hex.description: 32-byte SHA-256 of the canonical vault-head manifest (uuid -> content_nonce of content blobs only). The manifest object's own encoding is MYND-414's; here the head only anchors this hash.

input_seq.description: u64 auxiliary Lamport seq (max(parent_seq)+1). Encoded big-endian (8 bytes). Auxiliary only — VV is the authority (sync-protocol.md §4.1, §5.1 Pin).

input_parent_count.description: 0 = genesis, 1 = linear, 2 = merge. MUST equal the length of input_prev_head_hash_hex.

input_prev_head_hash_hex.description: 0..2 parent head_ids (each a 32-byte SHA-256, hex). MAY be supplied UNSORTED to pin that the encoder byte-sorts them ascending lexicographically (G2); the expected_head_mac_input_hex reflects the sorted order.

input_version_vector.description: The head's version vector. MAY be supplied UNSORTED to pin that the encoder sorts entries ascending by device_id (G1); the expected output reflects the canonical order (entry_count u32-BE, then per entry device_id||counter-u64-BE). No device_id may repeat.

input_author_device_id_hex.description: 16-byte author_device_id (hex). MUST satisfy VV[author] == max(parents)[author]+1 (==1 at genesis) — the §4.1 consistency check; a vector violating it belongs under case_kind 'verify' as a reject, not here.

expected_head_mac_input_hex.description: The full canonical head_mac_input bytes (hex): 'myne.v0.1|' || protocol_version || head_format_version || account_number_hash || manifest_hash || seq(8 BE) || parent_count || prev_head_hash[] (sorted, 32*count) || vv_len(4 BE) || vv_canonical. Pins G1/G2 and the encode-then-MAC layout (sync-protocol.md §3.2-§3.3).

expected_head_mac_hex.description: 32-byte HMAC-SHA-256(head_mac_key, head_mac_input), hex (full tag, no truncation).

expected_head_id_hex.description: 32-byte head_id = SHA-256(head_mac_input || head_mac), hex (G3 — binds the MAC, not just the content).

informational_head_mac_key_hex.description: 32-byte DeriveSubkey(root_key, 'vault-head-mac') output (hex). Informational — verified implicitly by expected_head_mac_hex; carried so reviewers need not re-derive.

oneOf.title: verify — pin the on-pull VV-dominance decision (sync-protocol.md §5.3)

input_baseline_version_vector.description: The device's persisted last-seen baseline VV (absent components = 0). Empty = a bootstrapping device (TOFU, §6) — for which the expected_decision is 'bootstrap_tofu'.

input_candidate_version_vector.description: The candidate head's VV (already MAC-verified; this case pins only the dominance comparison, not the MAC step).

expected_decision.description: The §5.3 outcome: 'extension' (candidate >= baseline componentwise, >=1 strictly greater -> accept); 'rollback' (any candidate component < baseline -> reject); 'incomparable_merge' (some greater, some less -> author a two-way merge head); 'bootstrap_tofu' (empty baseline -> trust-on-first-use adoption, §6, not a dominance result).
